fields.name: demo_placements
fields.description: Ordered list of target positions, in [y, x], on which the goal-named cube (the colour named in the goal instruction) was released during the DEMONSTRATION, in the order the releases happened. A release is a frame where the fingers go from ~46% open to ~100% open while that cube was 'held in the gripper' just before; the entry is the position of the target closest to the cube's resting spot right after that release, taken from the STABLE pre-shuffle target set: the four target positions that hold throughout the demonstration, as listed in the frames just before the final centre release and in the first parked frames after it. Do NOT read positions from the last demo frames: while the gripper is parked raised at about [54, 128], height 0.200, at the end of the demonstration, two targets may slide to new positions over a few frames (positions appear that match no earlier target), usually swapping places, and the final frames show the shuffled layout. Match the cube's resting spot after the release against the stable set even if the target under the cube is missing from the release frame because the gripper hides it. Do NOT include the demo's final release near the image centre (cube left around [82, 127], no target there), do not include the cube's starting spot, do not include button presses, and do not include a release that is onto the same target the cube was just lifted from if no target lies under the cube. Written at step #1 (the only step that shows the demonstration) and copied unchanged at every later step. Empty list only if no demonstration was shown. e.g. [[137, 103], [115, 85]]

fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: The position, in [y, x], AT THE START OF EXECUTION of the target that the goal instruction's ordinal picks out of demo_placements ('first' = entry 1, 'second' = entry 2, 'third' = entry 3, 'fourth' = entry 4), followed through the end-of-demonstration shuffle. Procedure: take the ordinal entry (its pre-shuffle position). In the parked frames at the end of the demonstration (gripper at about [54, 128], height 0.200, fingers 100% open), if the target list changes, track that target frame by frame: in each next frame it is the listed position nearest to its previous position among the positions not still occupied by an unmoved target; follow it until the list is stable again and write its settled position, which equals one of the four target positions in the first execution frame. If no target moves in the parked frames, goal_target equals the demo_placements entry. Written at step #1 from the demonstration and copied unchanged afterwards. unknown before the demonstration has been seen. e.g. entry 1 is [137, 103]; in the parked frames that target moved through [115, 110] and [98, 135] and settled at [101, 166], while the target from [101, 169] moved to [137, 103]; goal_target = [101, 166]
